pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti or AMD RX 5600 XT (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon VII (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High quality sound card supporting 5.1 surround
  • Additional Notes: For best performance, try using a newer technology like a 2080 Ti or higher, such as a 4060 or 4060 Ti. If possible, use a 250GB or higher SSD.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains content that may not be suitable for everyone and is generally considered mature. Examples include war, blood, death, and corpses. 
Players can witness these events from the moment they start the game. 
Additionally, a few dialogues throughout the game contain moderately strong language.
